current.title: Dedekind eta function
current.description: For Im(τ)>0 and q=exp(2πiτ), η(τ)=exp(πiτ/12)∏_(n≥1)(1−qⁿ). The explicit exponential prefactor specifies the meaning of q^(1/24) without choosing a complex root.
